epics.title: GitHub PR State Reconciliation
epics.jtbd: When I monitor task progress, I want internal task states to strictly mirror actual GitHub PR states, so that operational reality disagreements are eliminated.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce local-vs-GitHub PR state discrepancies to 0
requirements: R1: The system must enforce synchronization between internal task states and their actual GitHub PR states, resolving discrepancies where a task is marked 'done' but the PR is stuck or blocked.

slices.title: Patch GitHub PR state reconciliation logic
slices.jtbd: When implementing state synchronization for this epic, I want to patch the task state updater to verify against actual GitHub PR states, so that false 'done' statuses are eliminated.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an internal task marked as 'done',
When the corresponding GitHub PR is actually stuck or blocked,
Then the system must revert or block the 'done' state and log a discrepancy.
Given a test suite verifying state synchronization,
When the test runs,
Then it asserts that discrepancies between local and GitHub PR states are detected and resolved.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false 'done' records from state mismatches to 0
